description: Use this when someone asks what FindEnergyRates is, where its electricity data comes from, which states it covers, how plans are ranked, how fresh the data is, whether FindEnergyRates is paid, or how to cite it. Returns that, with the referral and broker disclosure and links to the privacy policy and terms. Takes no input. Do not use it for plans or rates (use electricity_search_plans or electricity_get_price_to_compare).
name: electricity_about
